collection.title: MG HS 2019 to 2023 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a MG HS 2019 Onwards model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 17" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
